description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways - Order under the Universities Act, to amend the Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 916/7 of 27.03.1996 entering "Department of Sociology" to the South Eastern University of Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of a university's academic structure through a legal order issued under the Universities Act. It constitutes a regulatory action (adding a new Department of Sociology) performed under statutory authority, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the Minister's name and title is incidental to the regulatory function being performed.
